body.x: Daeyoung Chaevi will exhibit electric car chargers at CES 2019, the world's largest technology exhibition in Las Vegas, USA from January 8 (Tue) to January 11 (Fri), 2019.

Daeyoung Chaevi is a provider of one-stop service solutions, from charger manufacturing to control and operation of electric vehicles. The company's chargers support a wide range of charging methods by country and by car manufacturer, and have a diverse lineup of products ranging from fast, mobile chargers to smart moving charging models that search for electric vehicles. Daeyoung Chaevi is leading the market as a service provider by developing an operating system that combines IoT-based control system and billing system.

Whilethe global automobile market is rapidly changing around eco-friendlyautomobiles, supply is becoming a problem because it cannot keep up withdemand. In addition, electric vehicle users are suffering from inconveniencesdue to lack of electric vehicle charging stations, long charging time, and lackof customer convenience. Daeyoung Chaevi has developed and supplied a varietyof charger lineups that can be quickly charged while meeting all chargingmethods.

DaeyoungChaevi's electric car charger features a charger's patented spring-loaded cablefor easy handling without being pulled to the floor. The charger is alsoconnected to the Daeyoung Chaevi operating system, so there is no additionalcommunication charge for user authentication. The company built a product usinga trendy curve design and succeeded in acquiring a technology patent that couldcharge multiple vehicles simultaneously with one power bank.

Inaddition, this charger is equipped with a credit card reader, QR code, NFC anda variety of smart payment is possible. With IoT technology, you can monitorreal-time status of charging guns, and you can also check the remaining batterycharge and estimated charge completion time through dedicated apps.

DaeyoungChaevi is spearheading the development of a future-oriented power distributionsystem that can smartly manage the unmanned charging system and recharginginfrastructure that are specialized for each application in line with thefuture intelligent automobile theme. Based on these technologies, they areplanning to enter the US, Mexico, Brazil, Australia, New Zealand, Middle East,Vietnam, Thailand, Singapore and European countries.

Currently,Daeyoung Chaevi is engaged in projects such as supply of common chargers withdomestic and foreign famous automobile manufacturers, and rapid chargingstation construction. Since it is held in various countries overseas, They wouldlike to find a good partner in the country at this CES and get another businessopportunity besides the ongoing project.
